title: Kit Green ran the CIA's 'weird desk'

tellings.quote: He ran the CIA's quote unquote weird desk for a long period of time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Kit Green, a scientist tied to the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, ran what Michels calls the CIA's weird desk for a long time. By that he means the part of the agency that dealt with strange subjects, which would make Green an insider on unexplained matters.
